crossRefs.note: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”
A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.
He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,

people.name: Golgotha
people.line: The place where Jesus was crucified, meaning "Place of a Skull."

translations.web: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”
